description: Chapelle-Lez-Herlaimont - Liaisons RCP is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Commune de Chapelle-lez-Herlaimont – Service Mobilité- Urbanisme. Ce jeu de données reprend les liaisons du Réseau de Cheminement Piéton (RCP) de Chapelle-lez-Herlaimont. Il s’agit du réseau coconstruit avec les citoyens et synthétisé par l’ASBL Tous à Pied. Il met en évidence les cheminements piétons structurants et les connexions avec les communes voisines. Coverage: Chapelle-lez-Herlaimont. The portal files it under Mobilité, Urbanisme, Patrimoine. The portal shows 225 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
